name: ExtraBar
tagline: Put shortcuts, links, and repeat actions in a customizable menu bar.
description:
Group everyday actions in menus for quick access to shortcuts, apps, and deep links. A floating bar gives those actions a separate place on the desktop. The developer says the core app works without special permissions.

## Pricing
Lifetime Access includes one year of updates. Forever Edition includes future updates.
pricingDetails: Lifetime and Forever one-time licenses available
